settings.hero_desc: A faithful replica of Michelangelo's David, reproduced with crisp anatomical detail and a clean white stone-look finish. A timeless statement sculpture for homes, studios, galleries and reception spaces - available in any size you need. Current pricing is based on a height of 60 cm.
settings.perso_placeholder: Finish, color or put your face
settings.s1_body: Bring one of the most famous sculptures in history into your own space. We manufacture a faithful replica of Michelangelo's David, capturing the pose, proportion and detail of the original, in a clean stone-look finish. Choose your size - from a tabletop piece to a grand floor-standing statue - and we can recreate other classical sculptures in the same way.
settings.case_body: Produced as a fun gift for an art collector by replacing David's face with the collector's own face, this David replica brings a piece of Renaissance art into a modern interior - a centrepiece for a home, studio or gallery, made to the size and finish the space calls for.
settings.case_quote: My friend's jaw dropped when he saw this - a gift he never expected. I can't wait to see how he shows it off to everyone.
settings.prov_p: Michelangelo's David has stood as a symbol of human artistry for over five centuries. The Diorama lets you bring that masterpiece - at any scale - into your own home or workspace.
